top_signals.title: Gold’s Lost Haven Allure to Swing Back Into View on Deficit Woes
top_signals.summary: As gold heads toward its worst annual loss in more than a decade, investors are gauging the odds a political shift in the US will restore the precious metal’s haven allure.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Tech Sell-Off Marks 'Crisis of Confidence,' Says Jordan Jackson
top_signals.summary:
Disappointing US megacap earnings accelerated a rotation out of AI-related tech last week, triggering a sharp selloff as investors shifted toward smaller-cap and more defensive areas.
Jordan Jackson, Global Market Strategist at JPMorgan Asset Management, discusses the overblown AI selloff and how he expects to see markets move after midterms. (Source: Bloomberg)
